name: DisequalityDispersion.Machine.all_congr_mem
typeText:
∀ {l : List.{0} Nat} {p q : Nat → Bool},
  (∀ (x : Nat), Membership.mem.{0, 0} l x → Eq.{1} (p x) (q x)) → Eq.{1} (List.all.{0} l p) (List.all.{0} l q)

source.code:
theorem all_congr_mem {l : List ℕ} {p q : ℕ → Bool} (h : ∀ x, x ∈ l → p x = q x) :
    l.all p = l.all q := by
  rw [Bool.eq_iff_iff, List.all_eq_true, List.all_eq_true]
  constructor
  · intro hp x hx; rw [← h x hx]; exact hp x hx
  · intro hq x hx; rw [h x hx]; exact hq x hx
